selection: All 21 L1 induced Avg@16 samples whose programmatic boundary detector returned violation; this is a detector-positive audit, not a random validation sample.

merge_rule.agreement: Use the matching labels from two independent blinded annotators.
merge_rule.disagreement: Use the third blinded arbitration decision for that axis only.

source_integrity: All 21 candidate outputs were matched against the private mapping SHA-256 values. The arbitration task and output text were exactly matched to both annotator workbooks. Workbook source text and labels were not modified during freezing.
limitation: This enriched sample can estimate the observed positive predictive value of the detector within its 21 hits, but cannot measure false negatives or validate overall boundary/success scoring.
